result.summary: Found 1 major issue: an unlocalized string key is displayed as a section heading. The rest of the page looks visually consistent.

issues.description: Section title shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated text (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Fix the missing translation entry so the key resolves to proper user-facing text, or add a fallback label.
